reviewed_by: Claude Code; root cause independently validated by a fresh subagent (code-troubleshooting skill)
reason: Live Core: after a deployment's crash-style recovery, seven goal-driven provider turns stayed interrupted for ~6 hours behind 'Stop it to continue' while their goals read running. A resume attempt set each goal running, its turn then failed to start, and the goal was not paused again. From then on _resume_stopped_turn skipped the turn (it only resumes turns of paused goals) and the idle-goal reconciler skipped the goal (it still had a pending turn): a silent deadlock. Fix: a running goal whose turn has automatic_retry_pending (and budget left) resumes like a paused one, without re-resuming the goal; operator stops, pauses and holds are still checked first. The retry error now carries the failure's exception type and message instead of dropping it. Selected: test_chat_stream_follow.py (new regression: the pass left the turn untouched on origin/main; existing settle/resume cases), test_restart_recovery_lifecycle.py, test_chat_goals.py and test_async_recovery.py (goal and restart-recovery behaviour around the changed gate).
exclusions: tests/v3/test_recovery_controls.py passes 8 and fails 3 PostgreSQL cases identically on origin/main, so it is not selected. Harness goal recovery is a different path and unchanged. No UI, setting or operator workflow changed beyond the recovered conversation resuming; no frontend, Playwright or LAN journey applies.
